note: Dialog sentences BOTH surfaces print, as prose segments: a string is constant words, an object is a name each surface draws as a chip (`quoted` says the plain-text spelling wraps it in straight double quotes). Read by `the_two_surfaces_build_every_shared_sentence_from_the_same_segments` in crates/dux-core/src/prose.rs and by prose.test.tsx in crates/dux-web/web. Adjacent strings are merged before comparing, so either side may split its constant words however it likes; the words and the names must be the same. Paths are outside any home directory because the terminal side home-collapses them. A single line break inside a sentence is where the terminal UI breaks the row; the web renders it as the space HTML makes of it.

cases.what: detaching an agent with several running tabs
segments: dux will ask

to shut down and wait up to 45 seconds for it to exit before forcing it. The agent stays in the list as Detached, and you can resume it later. Anything the agent is doing right now is interrupted. All 3 running tabs stop together.
